cohort: 159 cases of infant botulism and 318 healthy controls
finding: Slower intestinal transit time (≤1 bowel movement/day) was associated with infant botulism hospitalization, while other risk factors varied with age and control group.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with infant botulism hospitalization in infants ≤2 months old compared to neighborhood controls and <2 months old compared to neighborhood controls.
